purpose: Mandatory market inputs for Roy and other PB/strategy agents before producing an investment strategy.

required_reads.role: mandatory Korean morning market brief structure, source priority, freshness and link policy
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_MORNING_MARKET_BRIEF_CONTRACT_V1 and required_sections contains exactly 8 ordered sections
required_reads.fallback: Do not silently drop source links, basis timestamps, closed-market disclosures or the no-estimate rule.

required_reads.role: post-close market facts and deterministic Daily Market Pulse features for the morning brief
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_DAILY_MARKET_PULSE_V1; raw values are facts, derived values are rule outputs, and missing web enrichments remain null/DEGRADED
required_reads.fallback: If a preferred web source is unavailable, use only the explicitly labeled canonical fallback fields and state the limitation.

required_reads.role: official US/KR macro actuals, history, revisions and macro regimes
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_OFFICIAL_MACRO_V1; official actual and market consensus must remain source-separated
required_reads.fallback: If an official metric is SOURCE_PENDING/DEGRADED, do not invent or infer the missing official value from market prices.
If stale/unavailable, verify current CME FedWatch on the web before using any policy probability.

required_reads.role: rates, FX, energy, volatility, indices, TRI-POD
required_reads.usable_rule: Check freshness-status groups individually and each source timestamp. LIVE is a collection verdict, never a streaming quote guarantee.
required_reads.fallback: Use only verified groups; disclose stale/missing groups. Never infer current guidance from an expired analyst consensus.

required_reads.role: sector rotation and ETF relative strength
Immutable FedWatch observation history for PB and analyst comparison
required_reads.usable_rule: Match meeting_date, target range and current_target across snapshots; never interpret historical LIVE as current freshness

required_reads.role: Per-series historical coverage and source-checked history shards
required_reads.usable_rule: Check snapshot_id, field provenance, quality and value_vintage; FULL validates archive boundary only; only AS_RELEASED actuals are eligible for release-surprise backtests.

required_reads.role: Immutable full Daily Pulse observations and same-day revisions
required_reads.usable_rule: Select market_date_us and generated_kst; historical LIVE does not mean current freshness; AI commentary must reference snapshot_id.

required_reads.role: Mandatory source validity and warning status before using any market family
required_reads.usable_rule: Before trusting its published verdict, require a valid non-future generated_kst and current age <= freshness_policy.max_status_age_seconds (default 7200). Then re-evaluate the relevant group timestamps and regime effective window at read time. LIVE_WITH_WARNINGS is not blanket permission.
required_reads.fallback: If the assessment is stale/missing, report STATUS_STALE/UNKNOWN; verify the specific underlying source independently before using it. Do not relabel an old completed-session observation as live streaming data.

required_reads.usable_rule: Use as current guidance only when start_kst <= current time <= end_kst AND source.consensus_status == CLOSED AND authority does not indicate PROVISIONAL AND freshness.groups.market_regime.state == LIVE. Missing consensus, PROVISIONAL, and stored SCHEDULED/LIVE alone are insufficient.
required_reads.fallback: State 현재 유효한 합의 레짐 없음. Treat expired contents as historical only; existing strategy rules keep precedence. Do not fabricate a new consensus.

required_reads.usable_rule: Never treat as current consensus or order authority; check original report, consensus status, source dates and effective window.
required_reads.fallback: If unavailable or expired, continue without current analyst reference.

fed_watch_policy.preferred_product: CME FedWatch API when licensed; otherwise CME 30-Day Fed Funds settlement-derived probability using CME methodology
fed_watch_policy.stale_behavior: Never quote a stale probability as a current fact. Refresh/verify first.
fed_watch_policy.material_change_rule: A 5 percentage-point or larger 1-day change in hike/cut probability must be explicitly surfaced in strategy rationale.

history.comparison: Compare same FOMC meeting and target range; observe current_target changes and methodology revision

agent_instruction: Before strategy or morning-brief generation, read all required sources including morning-brief-contract.json, daily-market-pulse.json and official-macro.json. For the morning brief, verify the preferred public web sources, state each number's reference date/time and source, preserve raw/derived/commentary separation, and never estimate a value that did not update. For investment strategy, do not infer missing FedWatch or official macro values.

official_macro_policy.scope: Official macro only. Keep real yields, HY spreads, breadth, SOXX/QQQ and other market-price indicators outside this contract until the separate market-indicator phase.
official_macro_policy.actual_ssot: Fed/BLS/BEA/BOK/KOSTAT/KCS/MOTIE as applicable; transport layers must be identified separately.
official_macro_policy.history: Use 10-year history where available and preserve YoY/MoM/3M annualized/6M annualized features for inflation indices.
official_macro_policy.revisions: Never overwrite revisions silently. Read vintage_history for release revisions.
official_macro_policy.consensus: Consensus is market data, never an official-source actual.
official_macro_policy.regime: Regime labels are informational features and must not be used as a standalone trade trigger.

morning_market_brief_policy.web_verification: Required for every daily brief even when SSOT canonical fallback values exist.
morning_market_brief_policy.basis_time: State market/reference date and observation time next to numerical claims.
morning_market_brief_policy.closed_market: Use latest completed trading session and disclose it; never estimate missing values.
morning_market_brief_policy.link_policy: Show clickable primary source link next to the relevant section and repeat all links in the final 바로가기 section.
morning_market_brief_policy.fact_boundary: raw observations != deterministic derived labels != AI commentary
morning_market_brief_policy.collection_timing: Single production FINAL snapshot at US regular-session close +10 minutes; 05:10 KST during US DST and 06:10 KST during US standard time.

calendar_history_policy.completeness: Use per-series observed quality; release-frequency completeness is not yet validated.
calendar_history_policy.alias: US NFP exact aliases connect to canonical nfp; originals remain preserved.
calendar_history_policy.vintage: BACKFILLED_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED is historical market data, not necessarily first-release actual.
calendar_history_policy.source_precedence: OFFICIAL > SECONDARY > MARKET_FEED; consensus provenance is separate.

freshness_assessment_policy.scope: Validity of the status assessment, not the observation age of daily/monthly sources.
freshness_assessment_policy.watchdog: watchdog-status.json is a US close-recovery execution record, not continuous whole-market health; use checked_kst and next_check_due_kst when supplied.
